name: Tools of the Trade 4 - Reinforced Spade
description:
The reinforced spade will do everything the basic spade does, but better. It further increases your chances of bonus seeds based on the resistance stat. Every ten points of resistance increases the MINIMUM seed drop by one. That means:

1 Resist = 10% seed drop
10 Resist = 1 guaranteed seed drop
15 Resist = 1 guaranteed seed drop + 50% chance for a second seed drop!
31 Resist = 3 guaranteed seed drops + 10% chance for a fourth seed drop!!

Time to scale up farmhand.

[note]If you're removing a crop with your spade, sneaking will let you remove the crop without having to worry about the spade breaking the crop stick.[/note]
